_note: ROUND_46 P1. Split conformal with score 1-p(true label); singleton sets auto-decide, empty/two-label sets route to human review. Fairness is computed only where protected attributes exist (structured). No production artifact or threshold was modified.

method.auto_alert: set == {positive}; auto_clear: set == {negative}; review: empty or both
method.coverage: marginal split-conformal coverage; subgroups and Mondrian reported separately
method.bootstrap: percentile bootstrap B=2000; text repeats=50 group splits

structured_internal.boundary: Internal test mixes 4,181 Kaggle and 137 Mendeley rows; the production model trained on 408 other Mendeley rows, so the source contrast is same-source optimism, not an external validation.

structured_source_holdout.protocol: train on 80% Kaggle, calibrate on held-out 20% Kaggle, test on all 682 Mendeley
structured_source_holdout.boundary: Kaggle labels are self-reported binary; Mendeley labels are PHQ-9 >= 10. Coverage loss mixes covariate shift with label-definition shift.

fairness.reason: The Chinese corpus and the groupwise OOF table carry no gender, age, or source attribution. Group IDs denote sibling text families, not people or protected groups.

text_groupwise_oof.boundary: Repeated 50/50 group splits on OOF scores are group-aware, but the OOF base models saw the calibration groups during their own training folds. This is an approximate exchangeability check, not a strict held-out conformal guarantee.

fairness.reason: The depression physiological table has no gender, age, or protected attribute; the only metadata is source='depresjon'. n=157 is also too small for stable subgroup inference.

physio_v2.boundary: Calibration 153 rows, test 157 rows. At alpha=0.05 the 95th percentile is estimated from 153 points; interval endpoints are granular.

text_english_holdout.reason: The English Reddit holdout has no protected attributes and only one split; a repeated group split would need sibling provenance that is not present.

fusion.reason: No aligned three-modality labelled samples; no conformal or fairness unit exists.
